Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for SCTIMST Legal Consultant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the SCTIMST recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology recruitment is Legal Consultant.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Legal Consultant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Legal Consultant position at SCTIMST.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for the SCTIMST Legal Consultant post?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview date is 09-10-2026. Candidates should attend the interview on this date.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for the Legal Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an LLM degree with a minimum of three years of experience as a Legal Advisor/Consultant in a Government Department or Autonomous Body of State/Central Government/PSU.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Legal Consultant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Legal Consultant post is 62 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for the Legal Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 30,000/- Per Month, which is negotiable.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for the SCTIMST Legal Consultant recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General/OBC and SC/ST categories for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Legal Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Legal Consultant post will be based on a Walk-in Interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Sree Chitra Tirunal Institute for Medical Sciences and Technology (SCTIMST), Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala. The exact venue details will be in the official notification.
